name: worker-test-0f3493dd03/06-send-default-after-default-p.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statements list includes Panic and Lock statement, but does not include named worker declarations or worker send statements.
## Expressions: lists Start action, Wait action, Check expression and Trap expression, but does not list worker receive actions.

## Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.runtime lists sleep, onGracefulStop and StopHandler, with no ballerina/lang.future cancel support.
reason: The main path invokes sendToDefaultWithPanicAfterSendInDefault, which declares a named worker and exchanges a value through worker send/receive before panicking. Named workers and worker messaging are not covered by subset 10; supported panic/start/wait constructs do not establish support for that communication or its panic propagation behavior. This is decisive for feature classification.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and asynchronous/synchronous worker sends (-> and ->>) and receives (<-), including default-worker communication.
Future cancellation via f1.cancel() in additional functions is outside the supported langlib list.
test_design_notes: Whole file retains many unrelated worker, cancellation, lock, lambda and query scenarios while main executes only sendToDefaultWithPanicAfterSendInDefault.

The @panic marker is attached to the error-construction line immediately preceding panic err; the expected main outcome is an unhandled panic after a successful worker-to-default send/receive. No @args or @output markers appear.
